lesson.title: 7.2 Feelings and Needs
lesson.unit_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
lesson.unit_outcome: Name the body, feelings, clothes and the weather, say what you need and like, invite with Do you want to ...? and Let's, and ask for help when you do not understand.
lesson.lesson_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
lesson.goal: Recognize five feelings, say how a family member feels, ask How are you? and answer with I am ....
lesson.grammar_function: The baby is hungry. How are you? I am happy. I am thirsty. I need water.
lesson.prerequisite: 1.1-1.6 family; 3.2 I am; 5.2 food; 5.3 water; 5.6 need.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Ask How are you? and say how I feel.
